questions.question: What condition makes a linear system $Ax=b$ homogeneous?
Why does every homogeneous system have at least one solution?
options: The right-hand side can be chosen after solving.
Every homogeneous system has every vector as a solution.
The coefficient matrix must be invertible.

questions.question: What is the trivial solution of a homogeneous system?
options: Any vector with one zero entry.

questions.question: What question does the homogeneous system $Ax=0$ ask about the matrix $A$?
options: Whether every entry of $A$ is zero.
Whether $A$ has a nonzero right-hand side.
Which vectors are mapped to the zero vector by $A$.
Which vectors are mapped to themselves by $A$.

questions.question: When does a homogeneous system have nontrivial solutions?
options: When the right-hand side is nonzero.
When the zero vector fails to solve it.
When the coefficient matrix has no columns.

questions.question: Which system is homogeneous?
For $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\\3&4\end{pmatrix}$, which equation is homogeneous?
Does $x=\begin{pmatrix}0\\0\end{pmatrix}$ solve $\begin{pmatrix}1&-1\\2&3\end{pmatrix}x=0$?
options: No, because the matrix has nonzero entries.
Yes, but only if the matrix is square.
Yes, because multiplying by the zero vector gives the zero vector.
No, because homogeneous systems have no trivial solution.

questions.question: Which vector is a nontrivial solution of $x+y=0$?
What is the right-hand side vector for the homogeneous system $x-2y=0$, $3x+y=0$?
Why is the phrase “homogeneous system” not the same as “zero matrix system”?
options: Homogeneous means every solution is zero.
Homogeneous means $A$ must be the identity matrix.
Homogeneous refers to $b=0$, not to all entries of $A$ being zero.

questions.question: If a homogeneous system has more unknowns than independent equations, what often appears in its solution description?
options: Free parameters leading to nontrivial solutions.
A unique right-hand side chosen after solving.

questions.question: How is the solution set of $Ax=0$ related to the kernel of $A$?
options: They are the same set of vectors.
The kernel contains only the rows of $A$.
The solution set is the range of $A$.
The kernel is the right-hand side vector.

questions.question: Solve the homogeneous system $x+y=0$ and $x-y=0$.
For $A=\begin{pmatrix}1&2\end{pmatrix}$, what is one nontrivial solution of $Ax=0$?
What is the solution set of $\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}\boldsymbol x=\boldsymbol0$?
Why can a homogeneous system never be inconsistent?
options: Its coefficient matrix is always invertible.
The zero vector is always a solution.
Its augmented matrix has no rows.
It always has a nonzero right-hand side.

questions.question: If $Ax=0$ has a nonzero solution, what does that say about the columns of $A$?
options: They must all be zero columns.
They must form the standard basis.
They all have the same length.
They satisfy a nontrivial linear relation.

questions.question: Find a nontrivial solution of $x+y+z=0$.
The reduced form of a homogeneous system in variables $x,y,z$ is $x+2z=0$, $y-z=0$. Which parameterization is correct?
